sensitivity_normalisations.plate_vehicle_mean: per plate and clip, tiles pooled
per plate and clip, tiles pooled

rules.start_state: A1 C1: every forecast starts from the plate-matched vehicle state (mean first-clip latent of the plate's vehicle wells per tile position, normalised space; idr0064 vehicle = DMSO wells not kept for checks). Fallback when a plate has no usable vehicle well: the same line's vehicle wells on plates of the same imaging batch (listed). Secondary: the well's own first clip, reported beside.
rules.horizons: Horizon h = the stored clip whose last frame is the latest at or before h after drug addition (idr0119) or after the first frame (idr0064); windows in sets.<set>.clips.horizons. H1 primary: mean of 48 h and 72 h; 24 h and 96 h secondary. H2a primary (A1 C2): mean of 24 h and 48 h (both clips end before the 48 h re-dose); 72 h secondary. H2b primary: mean of 2, 3 and 4 h; 1 h secondary. H1c and H3 use the H1 horizons. The clip grid was fixed in D1 (starts every 6 frames), so A1's 16-24 h and 40-48 h windows are realised as 15-22.5 h and 39-46.5 h (frame times).
rules.redose_covariate: A1 C2: a per-plate 0/1 covariate 'medium change and re-dose at 48 h' given to every model (action-agnostic included); 1 for the six AU565 single-drug-only plates (study text), 0 for all other plates, including the three mixed AU565 plates holding both single-drug and combination wells (no 48 h signature in their vehicle wells, results/d2/au565_redose.json).
rules.h2a_baseline_singles: Author decision on status report 2: H2a baselines (additive composition, HSA, Bliss) and the ODE fit inputs use, for each component (drug, dose), the fit-role AU565 single-drug wells on plates without the 48 h re-dose (redose_48h 0) when any exist, otherwise those on re-dosed plates; each single's effect is taken against the AU565 fit vehicle wells of the same re-dose class (all AU565 fit vehicle wells if that class has none; the ODE vehicle condition follows the same preference). The source used per component is recorded (results/d4 gates baseline_single_sources; results/d3/ode_fit.json sources). Only the secondary 72 h H2a horizon can be affected: primary H2a horizons end at or before 48 h.
rules.normalisation: A1 C3. idr0119: per line and clip, mean and SD over the line's vehicle fields (tiles pooled), SD floored at the line's 5th percentile over clips x dimensions; sensitivity: per-plate vehicle centring. idr0064: per plate and clip, centred on the median over all compound wells of the plate; scaled by the per-dimension SD of training compound wells; sensitivity: DMSO-centred. Global standardisation (per-dimension mean and SD over training wells) is the plan's second sensitivity analysis.
rules.error: Primary error of a forecast = mean squared error over the 1,024 dimensions, averaged over tiles and fields of the well, over the primary horizon clips, then over replicate wells of the condition, then over 3 seeds.
rules.units: A1 C6: H1 drug x line x dose (test: interior test doses and test-line extrapolation doses); H2a combination condition (also reported without Lapatinib+Palbociclib); H2b compound; H1c drug x dose in the held-out line for drugs measured in all four lines (Doxorubicin, Gemcitabine, Paclitaxel, Palbociclib), all doses of that line, models trained on the other lines' H1 training wells; conditions outside every training line's measured dose range are excluded and counted (A1 C5).
rules.model_sets: H1 models: wells with h1_role train (selection: train_sel; validation: val and val_extrap). H2a models (A1 O4): AU565 wells with h2a_role train, selection train_sel, validation val. H1 models are never evaluated on H2a sets nor H2a models on H1 sets. H1c: dw_line_k per line k. H2b: idr0064 train / val / test compounds; DMSO vehicle wells are training; dmso_check wells are never fitted.
rules.decoders: Ridge (standardised inputs, alpha from 10^-1..10^5 by 5-fold GroupKFold over plates) from the normalised tile-mean latent of one clip to each readout target (src/drugworld/targets.py) of that clip and tile, fitted on fields that are training in every model set: idr0119 vehicle and H1 training wells outside H2a held-out sets, plus H2a training-pair combinations; idr0064 training compounds. G1 threshold = the D0 pilot GMM valley; pulse prominence = 3 x the median absolute frame-to-frame C/N change of DMSO tracks.
rules.f_decode: A1 O1: on training-split wells (the decoder training fields), ridge on the standardised raw tile-mean latent, alpha by inner CV over 10^-1..10^5, R^2 of pooled held-out predictions from 5-fold GroupKFold over plates (as in the D0 pilot); idr0119 log count >= 0.8 and G1 fraction >= 0.5; idr0064 Erk C/N >= 0.5. The provisional vehicle value is reported beside. A failure drops that set's decoded readouts (and for idr0119 the ODE comparisons) only.
rules.f_dose: Per drug x line, over its training-split doses (lowest and training interior doses; wells train and train_sel): displacement = Euclidean norm of the condition's mean normalised latent (fields, tiles and replicate wells averaged) at the 48 h clip minus the line's vehicle mean at that clip; Spearman rho of displacement vs dose. Pass if rho >= 0.6 for >= 50% of drug x line pairs. Vehicle is not a point (its displacement from itself is not a dose response); the variant with vehicle as dose 0 is reported beside.
rules.f_power: From the frozen split: H1 test held-out-dose conditions >= 20 (interior test plus test extrapolation), H2a test combination conditions >= 6, H2b test compounds >= 60. A shortfall drops that hypothesis before training.
rules.baselines: Plan section 7 unchanged; H1c other-lines baseline per A1 C5 (each training line's response interpolated in log dose at the held-out dose, inside its measured range). The H2a additive and HSA baselines use the same single-drug wells as the H2a models (A1 O4).
rules.statistics: Plan section 8 unchanged: one-sided Monte Carlo sign flip over held-out conditions, 100,000 draws, per-drug results; Holm across G-Dose, G-Combo, G-Compound, G-Plan on test; G-Compound Holm across structure sources (ECFP4, MoLFormer-XL, target class).
rules.grid: Plan section 6 unchanged: width {512, 768} x dropout {0.1, 0.3} x weight decay {0.05, 0.2}, lr 3e-4, batch 256, <= 12,000 steps, early stopping on the validation primary error every 250 steps, patience 3,000; 3 seeds (0, 1, 2) per family; dw_doseshuf / dw_structshuf permutation seed = 10,000 + model seed.

idr0119.drug: ECFP4 (1024 bits, as is) and MoLFormer-XL (768, as is); A1 C4
idr0119.dose: log10(dose / max dose of that drug over all lines), plus a vehicle indicator

idr0064.pca: fitted on the training compounds only (n = 300), random_state 0
idr0064.dose: single dose (2.5 uM): dose term 0, plus a vehicle indicator
